rationale: C03 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It shares the distinctive creation formula and exactly the same membership structure— a chairman and four other presidentially designated members—followed by study and recommendation duties, authority to hear interested representatives, mandatory interagency cooperation, nearly verbatim fiscal-year 1950/1951 Emergency Fund financing machinery, and a termination provision. C21 is also a strong structural and financial analogue, but its membership count and operative details are less closely matched. C18 shares the commission/cooperation/termination framework but much less distinctive language and machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby created a Commission to be known as the President's Commission on Migratory Labor, which shall consist of a Chairman and four other members to be designated by the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby created a board to be known as the President's Communications Policy Board which shall be composed of a chairman and four other members to be designated by the President.
shared_material.explanation: The creation clause, naming pattern, exact five-person composition, and presidential designation language closely match.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In connection with its studies and inquiries, the Commission is authorized to hold such public hearings and to hear such witnesses as it deems appropriate.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Board is authorized to hear and consult with representatives of industry and the Federal Government concerned with the subjects under study by the Board.
shared_material.explanation: Both empower the temporary presidential body to receive evidence or views connected with its assigned studies.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance ... as it may require in the performance of its duties.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Board in its work and to furnish the Board such information as it may require in the performance of its duties.
shared_material.explanation: This is substantially identical interagency cooperation machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: During the fiscal year 1950 ... shall be paid out of an allotment made by the President from the appropriation appearing under the heading "Emergency Fund for the President" in the Independent Offices Appropriation Act, 1950 ...; and during the fiscal year 1951 ... from any corresponding or like appropriation ... Such payments shall be made without regard to ... section 3681 ... section 9 of the Act of March 4, 1909 ... and such other provisions of law as the President may hereafter specify.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: During the fiscal year 1950 the expenditures of the Board and the traveling expenses and per diem allowances of the members thereof shall be paid out of an allotment made by the President from the appropriation appearing under the heading "Emergency Fund for the President" in the Independent Offices Appropriation Act, 1950 ...; and during the fiscal year 1951 the same shall be similarly paid from any corresponding or like appropriation ... Such payments shall be made without regard to ... section 3681 ... section 9 of the act of March 4, 1909 ... and ... such other laws as the President may hereafter specify.
shared_material.explanation: The unusually detailed two-fiscal-year funding and statutory-waiver provision is reproduced nearly verbatim and is strong evidence of direct template reuse.
